atoms.a: My dog is being held on a leash.

hint.text: Das present progressive wird für Handlungen der Gegenwart und das past progressive für Handlungen der Vergangenheit verwendet.

atoms.b: Jazz music ((was_being_played)) just as I left the park.

My favourite film ((was_being_watched)) at the cinema by my family while I was on a class trip.
You can have a seat soon, but the table ((is_being_cleaned)) at the moment.
